research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shippo is engaged in research and development focused on an embedded shipping label management interface, as described in the title 'Embedded shipping label management.' The abstract details a system where, upon receiving an indication to display a shipping label management interface within a site platform, an embedded element is shown to facilitate label management. This highlights Shippo’s work in streamlining label creation and management within platform interfaces.

overview_description.description: Shippo is a versatile shipping platform designed to help e-commerce businesses manage their shipping operations efficiently. It offers a multi-carrier shipping API and web app that connects businesses with over 40 global carriers, including USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL. Shippo provides tools for creating shipping labels, tracking packages, managing billing and invoicing, and accessing discounted shipping rates.

product.name: Shippo Shipping App
product.description: A web-based multi-carrier shipping application for comparing rates, creating and printing labels, tracking shipments, and managing e-commerce shipping workflows.

product.name: Shippo Shipping API
product.description: An API platform that lets marketplaces, software providers, high-volume brands, and logistics businesses embed multi-carrier shipping, rating, labeling, and tracking into their applications.

product.name: Shippo Shipping Insurance
product.description: A shipping insurance service that enables merchants to protect eligible shipments against loss or damage during delivery.

product.name: Shippo Post-Purchase Tracking and Returns
product.description: Post-purchase shipping tools that provide customers with shipment tracking updates and support merchant return workflows.

product.name: Shippo Carrier and Store Integrations
product.description: Connections to e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and national, regional, and international carriers for shipping data exchange and label fulfillment.
